description: React component for selecting and managing team membership in Mattermost, including fetching teams, handling user actions, and rendering UI elements for team selection, creation, and system management links.

classes.name: SelectTeam
classes.description: React component class for team selection and management in Mattermost.

methods.name: fetchMoreTeams

methods.description: Logs out the current user and redirects to login.
